I only read search summaries, not the venue pages, so treat all of this as unconfirmed. Most places don't publish per-head set menu prices, so each one needs an email.

Rooms that seem to fit about 14:
- BAO King's Cross: private room listed for up to 14, with a guide price of £35+ per person. It's the only one near your £35 target, and I don't know whether that includes drinks.
- Drake & Morgan King's Cross: private dining room listed at 14 seated. I found no set menu price. It's a pub-style group venue, so it may be flexible on price.
- Hawksmoor St Pancras (Sir Gilbert Scott's Room): one long table for 12-14. It's a steakhouse, so £35 is probably too low, but I found no price.
- The Tasting Room at St Pancras by Searcys: seats up to 14, no price found.
- The Midland Grand: a private room for up to 14, but the listing gave set menus at £75 and £125, so it's well over budget.

Ruled out:
- Decimo: seats 12, and set menus run £130-170 each.
- Barrafina Coal Drops Yard: its room is for 8-22 seated, with minimum spends of £1,500-2,000. That's too big and too costly for your 14 at £630.
- Granary Square Brasserie: listed at 20-38 seated, so too big.

I couldn't tell which of these rooms are basements, which matters for Rana. I'd email BAO and Drake & Morgan first. Ask whether a Thursday 10 Dec room is free for 14, whether a £35 set menu is possible, and whether there's a minimum spend.

Sources: SquareMeal, TagVenue, Hirespace, DesignMyNight and OpenTable listings, plus Barrafina's and Hawksmoor's own sites.
